label: Competent participation in at least some linguistic practices depends on learned practical…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation; attribution DEFERRED: Competent participation in at least some linguistic practices depends on learned practical capacities and shared regularities of action for which possession of further verbal interpretations alone is insufficient. This is a restricted claim about competence, not truth by agreement, universal cultural uniformity, or immunity from external criticism.
note: Unproved and unestablished. No Lean declaration, source claim or self-evidence marking. The bearing classification and strongest rivals are in docs/wittgenstein.md; existing formal boundaries do not establish this existential philosophical proposition.
